title: Crowd Rush
description: Lead a crowd of adorable blue runners down the track! Drag left or right to pick your gate: ×2 or +5? The right call depends on how many youve got — choose smart and your crowd snowballs into a stampede of hundreds! Red enemy mobs (and giant brutes worth 10!) block the road: crash into them and both sides melt away one-for-one in a wild brawl — bring more, win big. Made a bad pick? Rescue gates give you a comeback. Perfect runs feel glorious, a few mistakes still squeak through, careless runs get crushed. Reach the finish to win!
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Tank Craft Merge
description: Tank Craft is a fast-paced merge and defense game where smart upgrades decide the battle. Combine matching tanks to create stronger war machines, arrange your armored force, and fight waves of quirky zombies and monsters. Earn coins, collect diamonds, unlock powerful weapons, and unleash special skills such as nuclear bombs and lightning strikes. Upgrade your rank, expand your arsenal, claim valuable rewards, and build an unstoppable tank army!

title: Dilivery Challenge
description: Delivery Challenge is a fun adventure puzzle game where you help a young man overcome obstacles to deliver a gift to his girlfriend. Observe the terrain, choose the appropriate path, and avoid traps along the way. Each level presents a new challenge with increasing difficulty, requiring skill and logical thinking. The gameplay is simple, engaging, and suitable for entertainment anytime!
instructions: Arrow button to move Space to throw

description: Bubble Shooter Golden Football is a classical bubble shooter game in which you need to collect all the Golden Footballs by eliminating the other balls.
